name: Touei Izonsha wa Guuzou no Gekisakka no Shuchuu ni Chiru
original_name: 投影依存者は偶像の劇作家の手中に散る
source:
A disgraced former playwright turned celebrated eroge scenario writer, known as “Idol,” uses a disc that supposedly makes the “real” version of his own cult hit travel through time, and lands in Akihabara in 2009. There he meets five girls who call themselves the heroines of his game and have copied their looks perfectly. They worship him like a savior, but he begins to see them less as heroines and more as material for his own theater.

A denpa, grotesque, metafictional work. Based on the author’s novel of the same name, which is free to read on Pixiv.
